questions.question: Which new suite of applications in Zurich simplifies the hiring process for hiring managers, recruiters, and applicants?

explanation.correct: Hiring Experiences is a new suite of applications in Zurich built to simplify and improve the hiring process. It includes Manager Hub Hiring tab, Applicant Center, Recruiter Workspace, and Interview Management. Previously known as Talent Acquisition, it is now integrated into HRSD. See: https://www.servicenow.com/community/hrsd-blog/zurich-release-deep-dive-blog-hrsd/ba-p/3375480

wrongAnswers.explanation: Talent Management Suite is not the correct name for this Zurich HRSD feature.
Recruitment Center is not the name of this Zurich suite.
HR Hiring Hub is not the correct name for this feature.

source.excerpt: Hiring Experiences is built to simplify and improve the hiring process for hiring managers, recruiters, interviewers, and applicants.

questions.question: Which new AI agent in Zurich automatically creates a personalized onboarding plan for new hires including learning tasks and team introductions?

explanation.correct: Generate Onboarding Ramp-up Plan is a new Now Assist AI agent workflow in Zurich. It activates five days before start date with three agents: Input Gathering Agent (analyzes resumes, interviews, job descriptions), Plan Generator Agent (builds stage-based plan), and Reviewer Agent (presents plan to manager). See: https://www.servicenow.com/community/hrsd-blog/zurich-release-deep-dive-blog-hrsd/ba-p/3375480

wrongAnswers.explanation: Onboarding Assistant Agent is not the correct name for this Zurich AI agent.
New Hire Journey Creator is not the Zurich feature name.
Employee Starter Agent is not the correct name for this AI agent.

source.excerpt: Generate Onboarding Ramp-up Plan is an AI-powered workflow that automates and personalizes the onboarding experience.

questions.question: What does the Zurich HR Case Planner AI Agent provide to HR agents for resolving cases?

options.text: Step-by-step resolution plan with fulfillment steps and supporting content

explanation.correct: The HR Case Planner AI Agent in Zurich (part of Resolve HR Cases v2) compiles case details, fulfillment steps, and supporting content into a clear, step-by-step resolution plan. Agents can review, adjust, and approve the plan, which is saved to worknotes for audit purposes. See: https://www.servicenow.com/community/hrsd-blog/zurich-release-deep-dive-blog-hrsd/ba-p/3375480

wrongAnswers.explanation: The HR Case Planner generates resolution plans but doesn't automatically close cases.
Direct employee communication is not the primary function of the HR Case Planner.
Case priority scoring is not the main output of the HR Case Planner AI Agent.

source.excerpt: The HR Case Planner AI Agent compiles case details, fulfillment steps, and supporting content into a step-by-step resolution plan.

questions.question: Which new Zurich feature enables pre-hires to begin onboarding tasks ahead of their start date with limited-access roles?

explanation.correct: Pre-Hire Experience in Zurich enables pre-hires to begin onboarding tasks ahead of their start date, fostering early engagement. Security is preserved through limited-access roles, and automated transitions from pre-hire to employee reduce administrative overhead. See: https://www.servicenow.com/community/hrsd-blog/zurich-release-deep-dive-blog-hrsd/ba-p/3375480

wrongAnswers.explanation: Early Access Portal is not the correct name for this Zurich feature.
Candidate Onboarding is not the Zurich feature name for pre-hire engagement.
Future Employee Portal is not the correct name for this feature.

source.excerpt: Pre-Hire Experience enables pre-hires to begin onboarding tasks ahead of their start date with limited-access roles.

questions.question: What enhancement does Zurich bring to HR Multi-Instance Integration (HR MII) for provider agents?

options.text: Provider agents can manage consumer instance configurations
Provider agents can initiate ad-hoc approvals and assign HR tasks within remote HR cases
Provider agents can automatically sync employee data
Provider agents can modify consumer knowledge bases

explanation.correct: Zurich enhances HR MII so provider agents can now initiate ad-hoc approvals and assign HR tasks within remote HR cases created by consumer employees. All 13 task types are supported, including a new 'URL' task type. See: https://www.servicenow.com/community/hrsd-blog/zurich-release-deep-dive-blog-hrsd/ba-p/3375480

wrongAnswers.explanation: This is not the specific HR MII enhancement in Zurich.
Automatic employee data sync is not the highlighted Zurich HR MII enhancement.
Modifying consumer knowledge bases is not the Zurich HR MII feature.

source.excerpt: Provider agents can now initiate ad-hoc approvals and assign HR tasks within remote HR cases created by consumer employees.
